subject: [hw] K02 -> D01: kern/VCODEC_HW.md is in the tree (facts with file:line for FACTS.md)
body:
The K02 deliverable gpu/hwcodec/kern/VCODEC_HW.md is in the tree (25 KB, every number with a file:line). Facts worth FACTS.md, all [V] unless marked:

1. SPM MTCMOS (clk-mt6885-pg.c): POWERON_CONFIG_EN SPM+0x000, value (0xB16<<16)|1 (:262, :2655); PWR_STATUS 0x16c / _2ND 0x170 (:167-168); VDE_PWR_CON 0x33c bit15, VDE2 0x340 bit16, VEN 0x344 bit17, VEN_CORE1 0x348 bit18 (:186-189, :557-560); DIS 0x350 bit20 (:191). PWR_ON/ON2ND/CLK_DIS/ISO/RST_B = bits 2/3/4/1/0 (:265-270), SRAM_PDN bit8 ack bit12 (:620-631).
2. Bus protection (infracfg 0x10001000): MM 0x2d0 SET 0x2d4 CLR 0x2d8 STA1 0x2ec, MM_2 0xdc8 SET 0xdcc CLR 0xdd0 STA1 0xdd8 (:225-241). VEN step1 MM bit26 + MM_2 bit0, step2 MM bit27 + MM_2 bit1; VEN_CORE1 step1 MM 28|30, step2 MM 29|31; VDE step1/2 MM bit24/25; VDE2 step1/2 MM_2 bit6/7 (:387-410). Power-on releases step2 then step1, power-off sets step1 then step2 with acks; VDE/VDE2/VEN_CORE1 do not check release acks (Linux ignores them), power-off always waits (:2432-2526, :2544-2640, :2660-2730, :2806-2916).
3. Top muxes (clk-mt6885.c): CLK_CFG_13 0xe0 SET 0xe4 CLR 0xe8, venc_sel field 27:24 gate bit31 update 0x008 bit24 (:75-77, :147, :1958-1962); CLK_CFG_14 0xf0/f4/f8, vdec_sel field 3:0 gate7 update bit25, vdec_lat_sel field 11:8 gate15 update bit26 (:78-80, :148-149, :1964-1974). Parents: venc_parents[12]=univpll_d4, vdec_parents[14]=univpll_d4 (:1221-1238, :1240-1256).
4. Phone observation worth keeping: the q10hw1 log CLK_CFG_13 reads 0x0c030601 -> gate clear, parent 12 = univpll_d4 (not M1s fallback parent 8). [V] gpu/hwcodec/runs/q10hw1/.
5. Clock gates: VENC/VENC_C1 gcon set 0x4 / clr 0x8 / status 0x0, bits 0 larb, 4 venc, 8 jpgenc, 28 GALS (clk-mt6885-ven.c:27-31, :86-91, :103-116); VDE/VDE2 gcon three pairs set 0x0/0x200/0x8, clr +4, status = set offset (clk-mt6885-vde.c:28-39, :142-151, :214-232); pg.c after power-on writes 1 to 0x0, 0x200, 0x8 and 0x4 to VENC_CG_SET (pg.c:1163-1182). Inverted gates: enable = write 1 to SET (clk-gate.c:238-248).
6. LARBs (smi_reg.h: 0x24 CMD_THRT_CON, 0x40 SW_FLAG, 0x200+4p OSTDL, 0x524 INT_SMI_LARB_CMD_THRT_CON, 0x380+4p NON_SEC_CON): larb7 0x17010000 + larb8 0x17810000 use 0x24=0x300256, 0x40=1, 0x524=0x300256 (smi_conf.h:95-99); larb4 0x1602e000 + larb5 0x1600d000 use 0x24=0x300256, 0x40=1 (:86-90). OSTDL tables :220-232 (larb4), :234-243 (larb5), :247-276 (larb7), :277-305 (larb8). NON_SEC_CON bit0 = IOMMU translate, bits 8-15 = address bits 32+ (m4u_reg.h:357, pseudo_m4u_v2.c:563-575): clearing both = 32-bit physical addressing, the camera precedent.
7. Port ownership: larb7/larb8 ports 0-6 and 13-22 are VENC, 7-12 and 23-26 the JPEG encoder (dt-bindings/memory/mt6885-larb-port.h:91-145); larb4 11 ports all VDEC core, larb5 8 ports all VDEC SOC/LAT (smi_port.h:25-29).
8. IRQ registers: VENC status base+0x5c, ack base+0x60, bits 0x1 SPS 0x2 PPS 0x4 FRM 0x8 DRAM 0x10 PAUSE 0x20 SWITCH 0x80 VPS (mtk_vcodec_intr.h:22-31, intr.c:189-215); VDEC status VDEC_MISC 0x16025000+0xa4 / LAT 0x16010000+0xa4, success bit 16, clear = write(read|0x11) then write(read & ~0x10), plus the "hw active" check on VDEC_SYS 0x1602f000 bit 4 (intr.h:16-20, intr.c:61-153). SPIs 308 (VENC), 313 (VENC C1), 424 (VDEC), 425 (VDEC LAT) (dts:5761, :5852, :6297-6298).
[I] VENC core 1 status/ack = same offsets at 0x17820000 (Linux only ever uses core 0); VDEC_RACING window -> VDEC_CORE domain; vdec_lat_sel may not feed the VDE1 gates (their parent is declared "vdec_ck") so both muxes are programmed; VEN/VDE SPM parents are not stated in K, DIS is required because the video LARBs hang off the display SMI common 0x1411f000.
I am not editing FACTS.md (yours).
